fusions.name: Shed and Regrown
fusions.desc: Throws a tine at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, which deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets. 40% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 0.8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Leap into Cover
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood and pulls you into your shell: your armour rises by 25% for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spooked Stride
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 4% faster per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
